title: Integral comparisons for a finite extension of coefficient fields
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum of [def-pur-conventions], with $\ell\ne p$, and finite extensions $E\subset F$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation rings $R=\mathcal O_E\subset S=\mathcal O_F$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ smooth separated of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-sf-setting]. For a scheme $T$ in this setting put $R_T=\varprojlim_n(R/\ell^n)_T$ and $S_T=\varprojlim_n(S/\ell^n)_T$, the completed coefficient sheaves of [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers], and set $C_T(-)=(-)_{\mathcal O_F}=-\otimes^L_{R_T}S_T$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Integral bounded constructible categories mean [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed]. Towers and normalized towers mean [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, sk-def-sp-normalized-towers]; $R\varprojlim$ means the derived functor on strict towers, after restricting each level to the completed coefficient sheaf [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. Use $Rf_{!,\mathcal O_E}$ of [det-sp-integral-direct-image-tower] and $f^!_{\mathcal O_E}=H_{f,\mathcal O_E}$ with its adjunction and purity map of [det-sp-integral-adjunction-bijection], and likewise for $F$.

1. $C_T$ sends $D^b_c(T,\mathcal O_E)$ to $D^b_c(T,\mathcal O_F)$, commutes with derived inverse limits of strict towers of $R_T$-module complexes, and has reductions
$$
 C_T(K)\otimes^L_{S_T}(S/\ell^n)_T\simeq
 (K\otimes^L_{R_T}(R/\ell^n)_T)\otimes^L_{(R/\ell^n)_T}(S/\ell^n)_T.
$$
2. For $M\in D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)$ and $K\in D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$, the finite comparisons $b$ and $c$ of [det-sp-reduction-direct-image, det-sp-reduction-exceptional] for $R/\ell^n\to S/\ell^n$ are realized by maps in the derived categories of coefficient towers. Their derived limits give natural isomorphisms
$$
 C_Y(Rf_{!,\mathcal O_E}M)\simeq Rf_{!,\mathcal O_F}(C_XM),\qquad
 C_X(f^!_{\mathcal O_E}K)\simeq f^!_{\mathcal O_F}(C_YK).
$$
These comparisons carry the units and counits of the $E$-integral adjunction to those of the $F$-integral adjunction and intertwine the purity maps $\gamma_{f,\mathcal O_E}$ and $\gamma_{f,\mathcal O_F}$. For $E\subset F\subset L$ they compose to the comparisons for $E\subset L$, with derived tensor associativity identifications.
3. After inverting $\ell$ in the integral categories, using the rational categories and coefficient extensions of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], these are the comparisons
$$
 (Rf_{!,E}M_E)\otimes_E^L F\simeq Rf_{!,F}(M_E\otimes_E^L F),\qquad
 (f_E^*K_E(d)[2d])\otimes_E^L F\simeq f_F^*(K_E\otimes_E^L F)(d)[2d]
$$
for $M_E\in D^b_c(X,E)$ and $K_E\in D^b_c(Y,E)$, with the same unit, counit, purity and coefficient-composition compatibilities. Twists in the derived-complete and rationalized categories mean [def-coefficient-twists-detailed].

proof.text: Finite freeness gives invertibility of the completed comparison on complete inputs. Transfer intrinsic completeness to the legacy K-flat definition using an auxiliary characteristic distinct from ell, apply the finite-free comparison theorem, and transport scalar-extended constructibility back across its inverse. This proves ordinaryCompleted and ordinaryClosed without new holes.

Use compactness of X to make f quasi-compact and compactness of Y with its quasi-separatedness to apply Nagata, giving Nonempty (Compactification f). For each chosen compactification apply the exceptional whole-system comparison to its composite to obtain simultaneous D, b, domains, adjunctions and laws.

Choose the canonical reduction comparison for each inclusion, scheme and pair of presentations. Integral descent supplies simultaneous integral models, integral comparisons, their scalar-reduction normalizations, total-limit equations and coefficient cocycle. Apply rational descent to that same family and cocycle. Use the completed strict-limit lemma for the remaining independent strict-limit field, and assemble all these data in Result.
